note: only parts whose number is tied to a labelled control are placed: B1-B6 -> base buttons 42-47 (B1-B3 top row = 42-44, B4-B6 bottom row = 45-47), MODE positions 1-5 -> 60-64, and the throttle levers. The official sheet exists only as a blurry perspective photo of a printed page; its other leader lines (handle buttons 1-12, T1-T7, E1/E2, FLAPS, rotaries) cannot be traced reliably at that resolution, so those parts are left out rather than guessed. DISCREPANCY (report, catalog unchanged): on the CM2 sheet the two throttle-lever boxes are labelled X and Y and the thumb-stick box "13 / rX / rY"; the catalog has the levers on JOY_RX/JOY_RY and the thumb stick on JOY_X/JOY_Y (taken from a real older MT-50 CM unit, 03EB:2054). The thumb stick itself sits on the handle side and is not clearly visible from above.
